scope.selectionRule: 限定割当範囲のpersons_3行のみ。Wikipediaがあり、独立sweepに現行profileへ結合された本文locatorがないか、locatorが古いSHAに結び付いている行。persons_1行はこのfollow-upの割当外として除外。
scope.countDiscrepancy: 実際のpersons_3対象は31件（26件は有効locatorなし、5件はlocatorはあるがcurrent SHA未結合）。先行見積もりの24+7=31とは合計一致するが、内訳は26+5で異なる。元sweep全体を条件検索するとpersons_1の15件も出るが、今回のpersons_3 follow-up scopeから除外した。

method: Opened and read the live article body around the exact relevant list row, lead, or section. Compared article target and note scope to current profile gates; recomputed current whole-draft/evidence SHA and profile canonical SHA as SHA256(UTF-8(json.dumps(profile, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + newline), insertion order). This is a Wikipedia-link/body review, not full profile/primary-text closure. Article rows were inspected only for the assigned persons_3 subset; persons_1 rows appearing under the same stale-locator rule were excluded.

selfReviewBoundary: This is an independent body-read supplement to the prior sweep, not a re-review of self-authored profiles. It does not approve any profile author’s primary-content claims.
